description: Fingerprint sourced directly from zelda-totk.js's own checkValidSavegame() (vendored at /community-editors/zelda-totk/zelda-totk.js): checkValidSavegame() checks tempFile.readU32(0) === 0x01020304 (little-endian, i.e. bytes 04 03 02 01) and tempFile.fileSize in [2307552, 4194304) before locating the internal hash table. This app has no inline field editor for this game — a match here redirects to the bundled standalone community editor instead of opening the schema-driven editor UI.
